messages:
sam: Heads-up  quick design review for API keys UI. Proposal: replace modal create with a persistent inline 'new key' row at top of list. Also change empty state: show a soft-revoke CTA/banner for recently revoked keys so users can undo without losing context. Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/ui/creds-inline-v3.png

maria: Inline row could speed up flows for power users. Flag: we need to make scope selection discoverable. Suggest a tiny 'what are scopes?' link next to Create, or a secondary help tooltip.

lee: Engineering notes: inline create is doable. Important: do not fetch org-scopes on initial page load. We'll lazy-load when the user expands the scope picker. Also ensure expanding the row doesn't trap focus or break screen-reader order.

ada: Accessibility points: scope picker must be an accessible combobox (aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant). When the revoke banner appears, announce it with aria-live="polite"; when revoke completes use role="status" + aria-live="assertive" for the final state so SR users hear the result and undo option. Buttons need explicit aria-labels like "Undo revoke of API key my-key".

sam: Revoke flow idea: click Revoke -> row collapses into a yellow inline banner with two actions: "Undo" (primary) and "Delete permanently" (destructive). Avoiding a confirm modal keeps context. Microcopy options: (1) "Key revoked — Undo" vs (2) "Revoked — Delete permanently". I prefer (1), less alarmist.

maria: +1 on option (1). Also propose helper copy under create CTA: "Keys are scoped by role. Admins can rotate and limit keys later." Could cut down on overly-broad keys being created.

lee: Backend contract: revoke must be idempotent. We'll return a revoke job id; UI should show "Revoking..." and then either success (show undo banner) or error (inline retry with error reason). Prevent double clicks by disabling the revoke button until response.

ada: Additional a11y checklist for PR: combobox keyboard nav (arrow keys, typeahead), focus-visible styles on the scope pill and region/SLA pills, 4.5:1 contrast on any inline status pill, and ensure the undo button is reachable via keyboard before it times out. I'll attach snippets to the PR.

sam: Action items: (1) I'll update mocks and record a short Loom demo of keyboard flow. (2) @lee please add lazy-load scope behavior and revoke job states to the API spec. (3) @ada add explicit a11y acceptance criteria to the ticket. (4) @maria finalize microcopy and helper text.

ci-bot: sam opened branch feat/creds-inline-2179990000  CI passed. Preview: https://staging.redwood.local/preview/creds-inline-2179990000

maria: I'll write the short UX spec and let's plan an A/B test (2.5% of orgs) to compare modal vs inline create. If metrics look good we can roll to 50% next sprint.

sam: Thanks all  will post updated PNG + aria snippets once ready.
